text: Who hath believed{H539} our message?{H8052} and to whom hath the arm{H2220} of Jehovah{H3068} been revealed?{H1540}

For he grew up{H5927} before{H6440} him as a tender plant,{H3126} and as a root{H8328} out of a dry{H6723} ground:{H776} he hath no form{H8389} nor comeliness;{H1926} and when we see{H7200} him, there is no beauty{H4758} that we should desire{H2530} him.

He was despised,{H959} and rejected{H2310} of men;{H376} a man{H376} of sorrows,{H4341} and acquainted{H3045} with grief:{H2483} and as{H4564} one from whom men hide their face{H6440} he was despised;{H959} and we esteemed{H2803} him not.
Surely{H403} he hath borne{H5375} our griefs,{H2483} and carried{H5445} our sorrows;{H4341} yet we did esteem{H2803} him stricken,{H5060} smitten{H5221} of God,{H430} and afflicted.{H6031}

But he was wounded{H2490} for our transgressions,{H6588} he was bruised{H1792} for our iniquities;{H5771} the chastisement{H4148} of our peace{H7965} was upon him; and with his stripes{H2250} we are healed.{H7495}
All we like sheep{H6629} have gone astray;{H8582} we have turned{H6437} every one{H376} to his own way;{H1870} and Jehovah{H3068} hath laid{H6293} on him the iniquity{H5771} of us all.

He was oppressed,{H5065} yet when he was afflicted{H6031} he opened{H6605} not his mouth;{H6310} as a lamb{H7716} that is led{H2986} to the slaughter,{H2874} and as a sheep{H7353} that before{H6440} its shearers{H1494} is dumb,{H481} so he opened{H6605} not his mouth.{H6310}

By oppression{H6115} and judgment{H4941} he was taken{H3947} away; and as for his generation,{H1755} who [among them] considered{H7878} that he was cut off{H1504} out of the land{H776} of the living{H2416} for the transgression{H6588} of my people{H5971} to whom the stroke{H5061} [was due]?

And they made{H5414} his grave{H6913} with the wicked,{H7563} and with a rich{H6223} man in his death;{H4194} although he had done{H6213} no violence,{H2555} neither was any deceit{H4820} in his mouth.{H6310}

Yet it pleased{H2654} Jehovah{H3068} to bruise{H1792} him; he hath put him to grief:{H2470} when thou shalt make{H7760} his soul{H5315} an offering for sin,{H817} he shall see{H7200} [his] seed,{H2233} he shall prolong{H748} his days,{H3117} and the pleasure{H2656} of Jehovah{H3068} shall prosper{H6743} in his hand.{H3027}

He shall see{H7200} of the travail{H5999} of his soul,{H5315} [and] shall be satisfied:{H7646} by the knowledge{H1847} of himself shall my righteous{H6662} servant{H5650} justify{H6663} many;{H7227} and he shall bear{H5445} their iniquities.{H5771}

Therefore will I divide{H2505} him a portion with the great,{H7227} and he shall divide{H2505} the spoil{H7998} with the strong;{H6099} because he poured out{H6168} his soul{H5315} unto death,{H4194} and was numbered{H4487} with the transgressors:{H6586} yet he bare{H5375} the sin{H2399} of many,{H7227} and made intercession{H6293} for the transgressors.{H6586}
